mapper.select: SELECT FROM pricing_scheme_dimension WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
SELECT FROM pricing_scheme_dimension WHERE scheme_id=#{schemeId} AND is_deleted=0 ORDER BY dim_code
mapper.sql: is_deleted=0 AND scheme_id=#{schemeId} AND dim_code=#{dimCode} AND JSON_CONTAINS(dim_values, JSON_QUOTE(#{dimValue}))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pricing_scheme_dimension WHERE ORDER BY dim_code,id LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pricing_scheme_dimension (id,scheme_id,start_time,end_time,dim_code,dim_values,match_mode) SELECT #{id},#{schemeId},#{startTime},#{endTime},#{dimCode},#{dimValues},#{matchMode} FROM pricing_scheme WHERE id=#{schemeId} AND status='DRAFT' AND is_deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE pricing_scheme_dimension d SET d.dim_values=#{dimValues},d.match_mode=#{matchMode},d.row_version=d.row_version+1 WHERE d.id=#{id} AND d.row_version=#{rowVersion} AND d.is_deleted=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pricing_scheme s WHERE s.id=d.scheme_id AND s.status='DRAFT' AND s.is_deleted=0)

UPDATE pricing_scheme_dimension d SET d.is_deleted=1,d.row_version=d.row_version+1 WHERE d.id=#{id} AND d.row_version=#{rowVersion} AND d.is_deleted=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pricing_scheme s WHERE s.id=d.scheme_id AND s.status='DRAFT' AND s.is_deleted=0)
